mentions.name: Eternal Vault
mentions.description: A digital legacy vault service that lets people store information to be unlocked by trusted contacts after they die. The author worked on a continuity plan so vaults remain accessible to trusted contacts even if Eternal Vault itself ever shuts down.
mentions.problem: What happens if Eternal Vault itself shuts down, given people put their trust in it to be there when they are no more and their trusted contacts want to unlock their vault.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was chatting with a user of Eternal Vault (eternalvault.app), and we discussed about a grave problem that I always knew we had, but I just wasn't 100% sure how it could be solved.

evidence.value: I was chatting with a user of Eternal Vault (eternalvault.app), and we discussed about a grave problem that I always knew we had, but I just wasn't 100% sure how it could be solved.

mentions.name: Eternal Vault
mentions.description: Digital vault that lets people store documents and information they intend to share with loved ones after they die, so those materials can be accessed when needed.
mentions.problem: When someone dies, survivors get no extra time to access the documents and information that person meant to share with them.
mentions.audience: Family and loved ones who need access to a deceased person's documents and information.
mentions.source_excerpt:
When someone dies, you don't get even one extra second to access the documents and information they meant to share it with you.
Trying to fix this problem with Eternal Vault.
